newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's jobless total falls in May - minister.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's jobless total falls in May - minister.

text.p: The number of registered unemployed in Hungary dropped 10,500 to 471,800 in May, Hungarian news agency MTI reported Labour Minister Peter Kiss as saying on Tuesday.
In May, the number of registered unemployed was 25,000 less than in February and 18,000 less than in the same month of the previous year, Kiss said.
"For the first time in a long while, the number of people with jobs grew 10,000 in the first quarter of the year compared to the same period of 1996," he added.
Kiss did not give a percentage figure for May's jobless total. April unemployment stood at 10.8 percent, compared to 11.0 percent in March.
